title: Technical Apprentice
job_description:
For interested candidates, please attend the WALK-IN INTERVIEW on the following dates: 29/5/26 - Slot 9am / 10am / 11am 2/6/26 - Slot 2pm / 3pm 3/6/26 - Slot 9am / 10am / 11am 4/6/26 - Slot 3pm / 4pm 5/6/26 - Slot 9am / 10am / 11am / 3pm / 4pm Interview Venue : Thunder Print Sdn Bhd No.6463, Lorong Ayam Didik 2, Taman Ria Jaya Light Industrial Park, 08000 Sungai Petani, Kedah. Entrance : GATE 3 (Please refer security guard) Eligibility Criteria : SPM / SVM / STPM / SKM / Vocational / TVET / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering / Mechatronic / Automotive / others. Fresh graduates or candidates with interest in printing/production/machine operations . Pass or Credit in Mathematics & Science (SPM/SVM). Good in logical thinking & problem solving skills. Basic computer skills such as Word, Excel, Power Point. Committed to work full-time after completing the programme. Willing to work shifts (upon convert to full-time). Disciplined, detail-oriented, hardworking and eager to learn. Upon successful completion of the program, apprentices may progress into: Technical Path (Machine Specialist/Technician) or Management Path (Assistant Supervisor / Supervisor). Important Note : This program is ideal for individuals who are eager to learn, hands-on and passionate about building a long-term career in the printing industry.

Printing Industry Apprenticeship Programme (PIAP) : Kick start your career in the printing manufacturing industry with our structured 1 year Apprenticeship Program , designed to equip you with both strong technical knowledge and real hands on experience . Program Duration : 12 months (Theory & Hands-On Practical Training) Intake 2026 : 9 June 2026 Intake 2027 : 11 January 2027 What You’ll Learn • Printing Operations – Operate digital & offset machines, ensure quality output• Prepress – File setup, colour management & layout preparation• Production Process – Understand end-to-end printing workflow• Project Exposure – Participate in improvement or project tasks (based on capability) Why Join Us? FREE Training Program Apprenticeship hours : 5.5 days per week Monday to Friday 8am-5.12pm ; Saturday 8am-12.45pm Monthly Allowance Provided up to RM1700 EPF & SOCSO covered Structured learning with industry exposure. Practical experience with real production operations. Permanent / Full time job opportunities.

EPF SOCSO EIS Training Provided
